items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Well, we was out when I was playing with him. We worked at Texas Lines.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess he worked almost all the places along there. I remember anything at the famous door and... Yeah. Did you remember here at the famous door with him? Some place in the dream room or some place along on that side of the street?

Well, we was out when I was playing with him. We worked at Texas Lines. Worked some nice jobs out of town. Plenty of nice jobs. I worked with Smiling Joe out of town. All over Canal Street. Boydman Street and I worked.

I was going to ask about some of the old time pianists, since naturally we're interested in the old history as much as we can find. Yeah. A lot of those fellas are gone now, but there might be some you'd remember. Even people like Bernal San Diego who wasn't so old.

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Who was in Smiling Joe's group when you recorded?

ctx.x: We can check in Don Stagg and, uh, and Charlie Crump. Okay. Yeah. Who was in Smiling Joe's group when you recorded?
It was, it was me, I think.
